users.addDesc: Create an account that can sign in to this Securo server.
users.ssoOnly: This server only allows single sign-on, so users are added through your identity provider.
users.showing: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}} users. Search to narrow the list.
users.resetPasswordPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the current one
users.activeHint: Inactive users can't sign in. Their data is kept.
users.adminRoleHint: Administrators manage users and these server settings.
users.selfLocked: You can't change this for your own account.
users.deleteBody: This permanently deletes {{email}} and all their data. This can't be undone.

settings.registrationDesc: When off, only admins can create new user accounts.
settings.accountingSubtitle: How credit card transactions are counted in dashboards, reports and budgets.

accounting.cashDesc: Credit card purchases count on the day they happen (default).
accounting.accrualDesc: Credit card purchases count on the bill's due date, which reflects actual cash flow.

settings.providerCategoriesDesc: When off, synced transactions arrive uncategorized so only your rules apply.
settings.numberFormatDesc: How amounts are shown across the app, for everyone.

numberFormatHints.auto: Follows each currency's convention, like €1.000,00 or $1,000.00.

settings.dateFormatDesc: How dates are shown. Month names always follow each user's language.

dateFormatHints.auto: Matches the number format (day first in Europe, month first in the US).

settings.timezoneHelp: Calendar dates, recurring transactions, scheduled work and AI context use this timezone. Changes apply to new requests and jobs.
settings.timezoneSavedInvalid: The saved value {{value}} is not a timezone this server knows. {{zone}} is in use until it is changed.
settings.colorsDesc: The accent colors of the web app. The mobile app keeps its own palette.
